title: Can you identify the year and month with the highest rental orders created
question: Can you identify the year and month with the highest rental orders created by the store's staff for each store? Please list the store ID, the year, the month, and the total rentals for those dates.

prediction.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    s.store_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', r.rental_date) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
    CAST(strftime('%m', r.rental_date) AS INTEGER) AS mo,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
  FROM rental r
  JOIN staff st ON r.staff_id = st.staff_id
  JOIN store s ON st.store_id = s.store_id
  GROUP BY s.store_id, yr, mo
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    store_id,
    yr,
    mo,
    total_rentals,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY store_id
      ORDER BY total_rentals DESC, yr ASC, mo ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT
  store_id,
  yr AS year,
  mo AS month,
  total_rentals
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY store_id;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT s.store_id,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', r.rental_date) AS INT) AS yr,
         CAST(strftime('%m', r.rental_date) AS INT) AS mo,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental r
  JOIN staff st ON r.staff_id = st.staff_id
  JOIN store s ON st.store_id = s.store_id
  GROUP BY s.store_id, yr, mo
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT store_id, yr, mo, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, yr, mo) AS rn
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT store_id, yr AS year, mo AS month, cnt AS total_rentals
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY store_id;
